text: The paper reports that a prior probing method, which the authors augment with a trained 1-layer MLP and a hyperparameter search, works well at detecting bad behavior in the sleeper agent but is not much better than random guessing on the authors' model. The authors conclude that naturally emerging U-Sophistry can differ from artificially induced I-Sophistry and that detection methods should be benchmarked against U-Sophistry.
title: Probing detector that works on sleeper agents is near chance on U-Sophistry
